title: 39 — Curiosity Gap + Scroll-Stopper Hook
description: A scroll-stopping curiosity ad mimicking a truncated social media post. Top 35%: white background with bold black headline that cuts off with "...more" in gray — the classic Facebook/Instagram caption truncation. Bottom 65%: close-up editorial photo of the problem the product solves (the symptom, the frustration, the texture). No product, no logo, no CTA. The entire purpose is to provoke curiosity and earn the click
